newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Garden Ridge started with hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Garden Ridge started with hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said on Monday it initiated coverage of Garden Ridge Corp with a hold recommendation.
-- Analyst Alan Ritkin said he looked for continued weakness in the stock.
-- Its recent aggressive expansion "has put strains on the company's systems and flow of goods," he wrote.

-- Ritkin said he is "encouraged" by company's move to reduce its 1997 expansion to three to five stores from originally planned eight stores but noted that actions of this sort from a growth company are "typically not well-received by investors."
-- He said company's efforts to boost staff likely will have little on the fourth-quarter, when it generates 38 percent of sales and 78 percent of yearly earnings.
-- Over longer term, he looked for revenues to rise some 32 percent a year, mainly on growth in square footage, with potential earnings increase of 25 percent a year over the next two to three years.
-- Ritkin looked for fully diluted 1996 earnings to increase 9.2 percent to $0.52 a share, including net interest income of $1.3 million, from $0.46 in 1995.
-- Garden Ridge shares traded up 7/16 at 8-11/16. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
